::: {.lede}
The tools behind our discoveries, from AI models to molecular simulation and
the chemistry bench.
:::

[Our toolkit]{.eyebrow}

## Built across disciplines

Different questions need different tools. These are the methods we bring together
to move an idea from a data point toward an experiment.

::: {.skill-grid}
::: {.skill}
[Design with AI]{.skill-head}

**PyTorch**, **scikit-learn**, **XGBoost**, **LightGBM**, **RDKit** and **Uni-Mol**
help us model molecular activity and properties. **SHAP** helps explain the
predictions.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Explore targets]{.skill-head}

**AutoDock Vina**, **Open Babel** and **AlphaFold** support structure-based
screening and target exploration.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Watch molecules move]{.skill-head}

**GROMACS**, **AMBER**, **OpenMM** and **ACPYPE** help us simulate how molecules
behave over time.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Examine the details]{.skill-head}

**ORCA**, **Gaussian 16** and **xTB** let us study electronic structure and
energetics when a closer look is needed.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Make and test]{.skill-head}

We synthesise new compounds and measure their activity in enzyme inhibition and
cell-based assays.
:::

::: {.skill}
[See the structure]{.skill-head}

**PyMOL** helps us inspect molecular structures and share what we see.
:::
:::
